safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes 4-day itchy rash and includes chest, but does not document dry skin or involvement of the back (and instead lists hands/inside elbows).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “dry skin” and back involvement slightly reduces the precision of the dermatologic history and may bias the clinician toward a different rash distribution, but it is unlikely to change immediate safety-critical management in an otherwise stable, non-systemically unwell patient.

safety_verdicts.content: The skin is also described as sore and cracked.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document “cracked” skin can miss an important clue for severity and barrier breakdown (risk of secondary infection), but the note still captures soreness/itch and absence of pus/blood, so near-term harm is limited.
